params.topic: Finland Veikkausliiga 2019-2026 historical fixture and pre-match odds gap supplement
questions: For every identifiable fixture in seasons 2019 through 2026, return stable fixture identity: season, date, home team, away team, official round when explicitly stated, venue when explicitly stated, and 90-minute final score/result when explicitly stated.

For every identifiable fixture, retrieve bookmaker-labelled 1X2 pre-match odds only when the source explicitly distinguishes opening/initial and closing/latest semantics. Return opening_home, opening_draw, opening_away, closing_home, closing_draw, closing_away, bookmaker, market, source_url, source_name, fetched_at, and source field locator.
Preserve rows with missing values and report expected, discovered, complete, partial, and unmatched counts by season. Preserve competing source values as conflicts; do not choose a winner.

notes: Evidence-only supplement. Do not infer opening odds from latest odds, do not infer rounds or venue from date/order, and do not write formal Snapshot/Outcome/Review/Gold or registry records.
